views.front: The three separate seat and back cushions now sit against a coherent connected terracotta support.
views.rear: Full rear detail shows one continuous curved upholstered back meeting both arms and the original base sections.
views.detail: The former unsupported gaps are backed by the new structure while the separate lofted cushions and restrained cloth remain legible.
views.underside: The three closed seat bases and original metal feet remain complete; the connected rear support meets the platforms.
views.clay: The overall curved construction remains readable without color and no longer depends on isolated floating back pads.
